accessNotes: 1) WebFetch was blocked by Cloudflare (HTTP 403) on every e8markets.com and help.e8markets.com URL. All content below was retrieved with curl + a desktop browser User-Agent, which returned HTTP 200. 2) e8markets.com is a Nuxt SPA. The pricing/configurator on https://e8markets.com/compare-simfi-funded-accounts is server-rendered ONLY for the default tab (Forex / E8 One / 6% drawdown / 80% payout). Tabs for E8 Pro and E8 Signature are rendered client-side and cannot be switched via any query parameter (verified against the page's JS bundle - no route-query tab selector exists). 3) The dedicated product pages /e8-pro and /e8-signature print the literal text 'Live pricing is unavailable right now. Configure any account on the challenges page instead.' in place of a price table when rendered server-side, so no prices are visible there. 4) The checkout host https://e8x.e8markets.com/orders/purchase is a JS-only shell (8.9 KB, no server-rendered prices). 5) Therefore E8 Pro and E8 Signature prices were taken from E8's own public products API at https://api.e8markets.com/api/v2/public/products - this is the exact endpoint the pricing page fetches (it is referenced as "/v2/public/products" in e8markets.com's own JS bundle, and the same object is embedded in https://e8markets.com/compare-simfi-funded-accounts/_payload.json). It is on the firm's own domain and returns plain readable JSON. E8 One prices from that API were cross-checked against the server-rendered HTML pricing cards and matched exactly ($488 list on $100K), which validates the API as the price source. 6) Prices recorded are LIST prices. A first-order promo code 'E8' is advertised on the page (10% off E8 One, 25% off E8 Pro and E8 Signature per the site's own JS config); discounted amounts are not recorded here. 7) Prices for E8 One and E8 Pro are the BASE configuration only (E8 One: 6% drawdown + 80% split; E8 Pro: 8% drawdown + 80% split). Both products are customizable at checkout and the price changes with the chosen drawdown and profit split. I could NOT read the price for any non-base configuration - the price formula is not published in human-readable form and the checkout is JS-gated. Those are left uncaptured rather than computed. 8) Crypto variants exist as separate SKUs (E8 One Crypto, E8 Pro Crypto, E8 Signature Crypto) with identical published prices and identical rule parameters in the same API object; they are not duplicated below. Leverage differs (Crypto 1:1). 9) E8 Zero and all futures products are sold on a separate brand/domain (e8futures.com, helpfutures.e8markets.com) and were NOT captured. The E8 Zero help article on help.e8markets.com is explicitly flagged 'Legacy product'. 10) The site is geo/entity-split: 'Access to the MT5 platform is restricted to US citizens'; services are not offered to residents of Cuba, Syria, Iran, Lebanon, Iraq, Yemen, North Korea, Russia, Ukraine, Belarus.

notes: maxLossPct left NULL on purpose: the max loss is not a single percentage, it varies by account size. Verbatim: '$1,000 EOD - $25,000 account / $2,000 EOD - $50,000 account / $3,000 EOD - $100,000 account / $4,500 EOD - $150,000 account' (= 4% on $25K and $50K, 3% on $100K and $150K). The product page hero states '3-4% EOD drawdown'.

dailyLossPct left NULL on purpose: there is NO daily loss limit in the challenge stage. On the Performance account there is a soft limit, not a breach: '2% Daily pause - A soft daily loss limit based on your starting balance of the day. If your floating or closed loss reaches 2%, trading stops until the next day. Your account is not breached.'

minTradingDays left NULL: no minimum trading days figure is published for the challenge stage. For payouts: 'Minimum profitable days between each payout: 5 (does not apply for first payout)' and 'A profitable day is considered as a day where the realized closed PnL equals to 0.3% or more.'
maxTradingDays: 'Unlimited Trading Days - There is no time limit but you need to place and close at least one trade each 60 days.'
Minimum payout $100: 'Minimum payout is $100. Amounts are taken from your net profit. Meaning, with 80% payout, you need to request at least $125.'
Payout buffer: 'Before you can start requesting payout, you need to leave a buffer in your account in the same size as your EOD Dynamic Drawdown. The buffer can not be requested.'

Payout caps apply (published table on https://e8markets.com/e8-signature): 1st/2nd payout $1,000 ($25K), $1,250 ($50K), $2,250 ($100K), $3,250 ($150K); rising to $1,500 / $3,250 / $4,250 / $5,250 from the 5th payout onward.

Weekend/overnight 'Not allowed' is taken from the firm's own product comparison table (Weekend Holding: No; Overnight holding: No for E8 Signature) and corroborated by the forced daily flat at 23:00 server time.
